label: B_Plasma
definition: B lymphocytes and antibody-secreting plasma cells.

label: CAF_Stromal
definition: Cancer-associated fibroblasts and other stromal fibroblast-like cells.

label: Cycling
definition: Cells in cell cycle regardless of lineage (used as orthogonal flag).

label: DC_APC
definition: Professional antigen-presenting dendritic cells (cDC1, cDC2, migratory, pDC when distinguishable).

label: Myeloid
definition: Monocytes, macrophages, dendritic cells, and related innate myeloid cells.

label: T_NK
definition: All T and NK lymphocytes expressing CD3, CD4, CD8, or NK receptors.

label: Tumor_like
definition: Malignant or tumor epithelial-like cells (cancer-type specific).

label: Macrophage
definition: Tissue macrophages including C1QC+ and TREM2+ subsets.

label: NK
definition: CD3- NK receptor+ cytotoxic innate lymphoid cells.

label: NKT_like
definition: Cells co-expressing T-cell and NK markers.

label: Treg
definition: CD3+ CD4+ FOXP3+ regulatory T cells.

label: CD4_helper_like
definition: CD4 T cells with helper cytokine or CCR7/TCF7 signatures.

label: CD8_cytotoxic_like
reliability_rule: Requires at least two cytotoxic markers and CD8 marker support.

label: CD8_exhausted_like
definition: PDCD1+ LAG3+ HAVCR2+ exhausted CD8 T cells.
reliability_rule: Requires at least two exhaustion markers; not defined by PDCD1 alone.

label: CD8_progenitor_exhausted_like
reliability_rule: Requires TCF7/CCR7 with low terminal exhaustion score.

label: CD8_terminal_exhausted_like
definition: TCF7- HAVCR2+ terminal exhausted CD8 T cells.
reliability_rule: Requires high terminal exhaustion score and low progenitor score.

label: NK_cytotoxic_like
definition: GNLY+ PRF1+ GZMB+ cytotoxic NK cells.

label: TLS_B_like
definition: B cells with tertiary lymphoid structure signatures (CXCR5/BCL6 context).
reliability_rule: Requires TLS context or CXCL13+ niche.

label: TREM2_macrophage_like
reliability_rule: Requires TREM2 expression plus macrophage core markers.

label: stress_dissociation_like
reliability_rule: Flag only; downgrade to unknown or coarse parent if ambiguous.

label: suppressive_myeloid_like
definition: Myeloid cells with IL10/TGFB/ARG1 suppressive signatures (radar only).
reliability_rule: Requires multiple suppressive markers; not defined by TGFB1 alone.

label: tumor_IFN_APM_high_like
definition: Tumor cells with high interferon/ antigen-presentation machinery (B2M/HLA/IRF1).

label: tumor_WNT_exclusion_like
definition: Tumor cells with WNT/beta-catenin immune-exclusion signature (CTNNB1/AXIN2/WNT5A radar).
reliability_rule: Radar only; not a response claim.
